description: Short reference texts for building on BrewPage. Topic `page-data`: how a published page saves what visitors enter (forms, guestbook, votes, leaderboard, game progress) with the script `https://brewpage.app/js/state.js` and the `state` config; meant to be read before writing such a page. Topic `custom-domain`: the steps that put a page or site on a domain the user owns (profile, DNS records, one check, statuses, problems and fixes).
name: get_guide
title: Read BrewPage guide
